summary: Three-step stream operation wrapper: acquire the stream lock with StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection(a1), run the inner operation sub_58C824(a1) forwarding the same stream handle, release the lock with AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave(a1), and return the inner result. A caller on the string-stream read path (StringStreamReadWithMaskCheck) uses it as a locked read primitive.

local_names.a1: stream/buffer handle used as the lock scope and forwarded to the inner operation
local_names.v1: return value: inner sub_58C824 result carried through the lock scope

operations.description: Acquire the stream lock with StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection(a1) using the stream handle a1 as the lock scope.
Run the inner operation: v1 = sub_58C824(a1), forwarding the stream handle unchanged; v1 holds the result returned to the caller.
Release the stream lock with AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave(a1) before returning.
Used by StringStreamReadWithMaskCheck on the string-stream read path, consistent with a locked read/forward wrapper.
Return v1, the inner sub_58C824 result, unchanged after the lock is released.

unresolved: sub_58C824's body is not in this packet; what operation it performs under the lock is not established beyond the forwarding of a1.
Whether StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection (0x0058C1B1) and AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave (0x0058C203) guard the same underlying critical section is inferred from naming, not proven here.
